mechanism_narrative: A stable federal funds rate below 5.5% indicates a neutral monetary policy stance that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 4.4% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE falls below 4.4%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 112.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing weakness signals economic slowdown, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 112.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 208.0 for two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 208.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) trend, measured by a 3-month moving average increase, indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS shows a 3-month rising trend.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1500.0), the S&P 500 tends to outperform as residential construction drives economic growth, producing positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) trend, measured by a 3-month moving average decrease, signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO shows a 3-month declining trend.
